title: HEBCS Model Schema
description: Formal input/output contract for the HEBCS wellness score model system

risk_classifiers_v1.description: 11 binary risk classifiers from NB04 (284-feature input)

clinical_risk_v2.description: 12 clinical risk models from NB06 (141-feature input)

output.interpretation: probability of risk condition (regression for glucose_level)

holistic_health_features.description: 284 features used by holistic_health_model and risk_classifiers_v1

ordered_names: med_Rugby Stimulant Laxative Plus Stool Softener

whatif_inputs.description: 9 user-adjustable inputs for the What-If simulator

hebcs_pathways.description: 7 HEBCS scoring pathways with trapezoidal biomarker mapping

feature_bridge.description: Translates NB04 284-feature daily space to NB06 141-feature session space

direct_semantic.description: Same underlying data, different naming convention

median_fallback.description: No NB04 equivalent; filled with NB06 training medians

nutrition_scale_factors.description: NB06 stores raw API daily sums; NB04 applies per-nutrient normalization (~12-31x)

bloody_bm_target.description: Model trained on 10.6% positive rate but predicts >50% positive on training data. Features bloody_bm_today and bloody_bm_prev are temporal leakers. Predictions should be interpreted cautiously. Practical impact mitigated by representative nutrition baseline patch.

nutrition_baseline.description: SimpleImputer medians were 0 for all nutrition features (97% of NB04 rows have no nutrition logged). Fixed by patching predict.py baseline with representative nonzero medians from 917+ days with logged nutrition data.
